messages.subject: Project Redwood – completion statement (completion 15 May)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Rebecca,

Our completion statement is attached. The balance due from Thornbury on completion is £16,537,108, made up of the purchase price (£18,500,000) less the deposit already paid (£1,850,000), less a rent apportionment in your favour of £149,692 (completion to the June quarter day), plus an insurance reimbursement to the Seller of £36,800.

Separately, SDLT of £914,500 and the HM Land Registry fee will be payable after completion. Please arrange for the balance to reach our client account by the morning of 15 May.
